Match reference iodine palette, but enlarge to high power; leave space beside nucleus for later coded leaders. Fine dark ink and layered watercolour school-science plate on TRUE transparent background, 10 percent clear margin, clean edges with no coloured fringe, no glow or ground shadow, no text labels numbers arrows scales brand people hands faces.
